name: bike-workshop
description: The back office of Velo Dielňa, a small bicycle repair and rental workshop in Banská Bystrica: its customers and their bikes, the service orders the workshop takes in and the parts it fits, the technicians who do the work, and a small rental fleet. The demo backend for the admin dashboard — see README.md.

sk-postal-code.description: A Slovak postal code: five digits, optionally split 3+2 by a space, as in '974 01'.

part-sku.description: The workshop's own stock-keeping unit: a two-to-four letter supplier prefix, a dash, then the supplier's part code, as in 'SHI-CN-M6100'.

order-number.description: A service-order number: SO, the year, and a four-digit sequence within it, as in 'SO-2026-0142'.

fleet-code.description: The code painted on a rental bike's top tube, as in 'RENT-007'.

order-ready.subject: Your bike is ready — order {{new.order_number}}
order-ready.body:
Hello,

the work on your bike under order {{new.order_number}} is finished and the bike is ready for collection at Velo Dielňa, Horná 12, Banská Bystrica (Mon–Fri 9:00–18:00, Sat 9:00–12:00).

Total to pay: {{new.total}} EUR.

Thank you,
Velo Dielňa

express-order-received.subject: Express order {{new.order_number}} taken in
express-order-received.body: An express service order {{new.order_number}} was taken in and is promised for {{new.promised_on}}. Please schedule it before the regular queue.

technicians.description: A mechanic who works in the workshop. The row is the workshop's own record of the person; 'user_id' links it to the sign-in account the person uses, which is what the service-order rules compare with the caller.

full_name.description: The technician's name as it is printed on a service order.

specialization.description: What the technician is best at. Orders for an e-bike go to someone certified for it.

hourly_rate.description: The labour rate charged for this technician's time, in EUR per hour, excluding VAT.

hired_on.description: The day the technician started at the workshop.

active.description: Whether the technician still takes orders. A technician who left stays on record, because old orders name them.

user_id.description: The id of the sign-in account this technician uses. Empty until an account is created for them.

orders_assigned.description: How many service orders name this technician, maintained by Alvo.

customers.description: A person who brings a bike in, or rents one. Audited, because the workshop answers to the customer for what it did with their bike.

email.description: Where order confirmations and 'your bike is ready' notices go. Unique: one customer record per address.

phone.description: The number the workshop calls when a repair needs the customer's approval.

loyalty_tier.description: The loyalty programme tier: 'club' members get 10 % off labour, 'team' riders (the local cycling club) 15 %.

marketing_consent.description: Whether the customer agreed to receive the spring-service newsletter (GDPR consent).

preferences.description: Free-form preferences the reception desk records — preferred contact channel, tyre pressure, saddle height.

notes.description: Anything reception should know before calling the customer.

bikes_count.description: How many bikes the customer has registered with the workshop, maintained by Alvo.

bikes.description: A customer's bicycle, registered the first time it comes in for service. The frame number identifies it across owners and orders.

model.description: The model name, as in 'Marlin 7' or 'Rockhopper Comp'.

category.description: What kind of bike it is, which decides the service checklist used.

model_year.description: The model year printed on the frame or in the purchase documents.

frame_number.description: The serial number stamped under the bottom bracket. Unique: two records with one frame number are one bike registered twice.

frame_size.description: The frame size as the manufacturer states it — 'M', '19"', '54 cm'.

color.description: The main colour, so the bike can be found in the rack.

is_electric.description: Whether the bike has a motor. E-bikes need a certified technician and a battery check on every visit.

battery_wh.description: The battery's capacity in watt-hours, for an e-bike.

purchased_on.description: When the customer bought the bike, which decides whether a repair falls under warranty.

service_orders_count.description: How many times the bike has been in, maintained by Alvo.

parts.description: A spare part or consumable the workshop stocks. What it costs the workshop is commercial information: technicians and reception see the selling price but not the purchase price or the margin.

sku.description: The workshop's stock-keeping unit, unique across the stock.

name.description: The part as it is printed on the invoice, as in 'Shimano Deore chain CN-M6100, 12-speed'.

category.description: Which shelf the part lives on.

unit_price.description: The selling price per unit in EUR, VAT included.

purchase_price.description: What the workshop pays the supplier per unit, in EUR. Visible and writable only to the manager.

margin.description: Selling price minus purchase price, per unit. Computed by the database; hidden exactly where the purchase price is, since one reveals the other.

stock_quantity.description: How many units are on the shelf right now.

reorder_level.description: When stock falls to this level the part goes on the next supplier order.

supplier.description: Who the workshop orders the part from.

discontinued.description: Whether the part is no longer re-ordered. It stays on record, because order lines name it.

compatibility.description: What the part fits — speeds, standards, wheel sizes — as the supplier's catalogue states it.

service_orders.description: One visit of one bike: what the customer asked for, what the technician found and did, and what it costs. Labour and parts are totalled by Alvo; the order moves through its statuses from 'received' to 'collected'.

order_number.description: The number on the paper tag hung on the bike, unique across all orders.

technician_id.description: The technician the order is assigned to. Cleared, not blocked, if the technician record is deleted.

assigned_user_id.description: The sign-in account of the assigned technician. The rules compare it with the caller, so a technician may work on their own orders and only read everyone else's.

status.description: Where the order is: taken in, diagnosed, waiting for parts, on the stand, ready for collection, collected, or cancelled.

priority.description: How urgent the job is. 'express' means same or next day, at a surcharge.

service_type.description: The kind of job, which sets the default checklist and price.

received_at.description: When the bike was taken in at the counter.

promised_on.description: The day the customer was told the bike would be ready.

completed_at.description: When the technician signed the work off. Stamped by the workshop's before-update hook when an order moves to 'ready'.

problem_description.description: What the customer reported, in their words.

work_notes.description: What the technician found and did.

internal_notes.description: Staff-only remarks. Never returned by the API and never published in its schema.

contact_email.description: Where to send the 'your bike is ready' notice. Usually the customer's address, copied at intake.

notify_customer.description: Whether the customer asked to be e-mailed when the bike is ready.

labour_hours.description: Hours of labour booked on the order.

labour_rate.description: The hourly labour rate charged, in EUR, VAT included — the technician's rate less any loyalty discount.

labour_total.description: Hours times rate, computed by the database.

parts_total.description: The sum of the order's lines, maintained by Alvo as lines are added, changed or removed.

lines_count.description: How many lines the order has, maintained by Alvo.

total.description: What the customer pays: labour plus parts. Computed by the database from the labour fields and the parts rollup.

diagnostics.description: Readings the technician took — chain wear, brake pad thickness, e-bike error codes — as the diagnostic tool exported them.

action.reject: This order was collected and is closed. Open a new service order for any follow-up work.
Only an order still at 'received', or a cancelled one, can be deleted. Cancel the order instead, so its history is kept.

order_lines.description: One line on a service order: a part fitted, or a flat-rate job. Deleted with its order; the order's parts total follows every change.

order_id.description: The order the line belongs to.

part_id.description: The stocked part fitted, if the line is one. Cleared if the part is later deleted, so the order keeps its history.

kind.description: Whether the line is a stocked part, a flat-rate job, or anything else.

description.description: The line as it is printed on the invoice.

quantity.description: How many units — or metres of brake cable.

unit_price.description: The price per unit in EUR, VAT included, as charged on this order.

line_total.description: Quantity times unit price, computed by the database.

warranty.description: Whether the part is replaced under warranty and invoiced to the supplier instead.

action.reject: An order line needs a positive quantity. To credit something back, add a line with a negative unit price.

rental_fleet.description: A bike the workshop owns and rents out by the day.

code.description: The code painted on the top tube, unique across the fleet.

category.description: What kind of bike it is.

frame_size.description: The frame size, so reception can match the bike to the rider.

daily_rate.description: The rental price per day in EUR.

deposit.description: The deposit taken at pick-up, in EUR.

in_service.description: Whether the bike is available to rent. Cleared while it is being repaired or after damage.

rentals_count.description: How many times the bike has been rented, maintained by Alvo.

revenue.description: What the bike has earned over all its rentals, maintained by Alvo.

rentals.description: One rental of one fleet bike to one customer, from pick-up to return.

starts_at.description: When the customer picks the bike up.

due_at.description: When the bike is due back.

returned_at.description: When the bike actually came back.

days.description: How many rental days are charged. Half days are charged as 0.5.

daily_rate.description: The daily rate agreed for this rental, in EUR.

price.description: Days times daily rate, computed by the database.

id_document.description: The number of the ID card or passport checked at pick-up. Never returned by the API once written.

damage_report.description: Anything found wrong with the bike on return.
